WardenGambitHelper

Introduction
I originally built this plugin for my own Warden gameplay but it may also be useful for other players now. To support that I also added broad localization coverage for German English and French.

WardenGambitHelper is a LOTRO plugin for Warden players who want to learn remember and use gambits with less guesswork. It reads your currently unlocked gambits and keeps them visible in a compact combat HUD so you do not need to search long skill panels while fighting. WardenEase was originally developed by Deusdictum but has since stopped updating it and has graciously allowed others to pick up where it was left off.

Per the original information:

WardenEase creates three bars that hold all of your gambits and another bar with quickslots. When you click on a gambit from one of the three bars the quickslots are filled with the gambit building skills needed to execute the gambit. Simply click the skills in order to execute it.
